capture_rule: Capture every byte and every compound, citation, dataset, property, variable, constraint, phase, uncertainty and point from each complete NIST ThermoML source. Construct the empirical vector from every direct-value binary, self or tracer diffusion-coefficient point in those sources. Preserve every viscosity, conductivity, density, phase-equilibrium, volumetric and other companion dataset but exclude it from diffusion measurements. Do not select species, media, phases, compositions, temperatures, pressures, methods, datasets or rows within a source.
source_selection_boundary: The three complete authoritative sources are fixed before any measured value, uncertainty or target hash is captured and before executable-law registration, candidate enumeration or prediction-program construction. The selection spans binary, self and tracer diffusion across aqueous, molecular, ionic-liquid and sub/supercritical media without using a result value.
